// Package onboardingpathexecution owns the isolated S9 execution workflow.
// It deliberately does not depend on courseplan: S9 cannot construct a legacy
// StudentPlanningProfile, PlanningIntent, mastery projection, or defaults.
package onboardingpathexecution

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"sort"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/pedagogy"
)

// FrozenSnapshot is write-once evidence for the exact Student observation and
// deterministic hierarchy that was admitted for S9 authoring.
type FrozenSnapshot struct {
	Schema    string                                  `json:"schema"`
	Readiness domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot `json:"readiness"`
	Authoring domain.OnboardingPathAuthoringInput     `json:"authoring"`
	Course    domain.GeneratedCourse                  `json:"course"`
}

const frozenSnapshotSchema = "planner-onboarding-path-frozen-snapshot.v1"

// BuildFrozenSnapshot uses only the S9-authorized inputs. Every graph target
// remains included: S9 performs no mastery analysis and cannot create a gap or
// no-gap interpretation from Student preferences.
func BuildFrozenSnapshot(graph domain.GoalGraph, policy domain.PolicyBundle, snapshot domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, strategies pedagogy.Registry) (FrozenSnapshot, string, error) {
	graph, err := domain.NormalizeGoalGraph(graph)
	if err != nil {
		return FrozenSnapshot{}, "", err
	}
	policy, err = domain.NormalizePolicyBundle(policy)
	if err != nil {
		return FrozenSnapshot{}, "", err
	}
	snapshot, err = domain.NormalizeStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		return FrozenSnapshot{}, "", err
	}
	authoring, err := domain.NewOnboardingPathAuthoringInput(graph, policy, snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		return FrozenSnapshot{}, "", err
	}
	fingerprint, err := authoring.Hash()
	if err != nil {
		return FrozenSnapshot{}, "", err
	}
	ordered, err := domain.OrderGoalTargets(graph.Targets)
	if err != nil {
		return FrozenSnapshot{}, "", err
	}
	transitions := s9Transitions(graph.Transitions, authoring.KnownStacks)
	course, err := s9Course(graph, policy, authoring, fingerprint, ordered, transitions, strategies)
	if err != nil {
		return FrozenSnapshot{}, "", err
	}
	result := FrozenSnapshot{Schema: frozenSnapshotSchema, Readiness: snapshot, Authoring: authoring, Course: course}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(result)
	if err != nil {
		return FrozenSnapshot{}, "", err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	return result, hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
}

func DecodeFrozenSnapshot(raw []byte) (FrozenSnapshot, error) {
	var result FrozenSnapshot
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&result); err != nil || result.Schema != frozenSnapshotSchema {
		return FrozenSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return FrozenSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(result.Readiness); err != nil {
		return FrozenSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := result.Authoring.Hash(); err != nil || result.Course.Fingerprint == "" || result.Course.Fingerprint != mustAuthoringHash(result.Authoring) {
		return FrozenSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return result, nil
}

func mustAuthoringHash(input domain.OnboardingPathAuthoringInput) string {
	hash, _ := input.Hash()
	return hash
}

func s9Transitions(inputs []domain.TransitionKnowledge, stacks []string) []domain.TransitionKnowledge {
	set := make(map[string]struct{}, len(stacks))
	for _, stack := range stacks {
		set[stack] = struct{}{}
	}
	result := make([]domain.TransitionKnowledge, 0, len(inputs))
	for _, transition := range inputs {
		if _, ok := set[transition.SourceStack]; ok {
			result = append(result, transition)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool {
		return result[i].SourceStack+"\x00"+domain.TargetIdentity(result[i].Target) < result[j].SourceStack+"\x00"+domain.TargetIdentity(result[j].Target)
	})
	return result
}

func s9Course(graph domain.GoalGraph, policy domain.PolicyBundle, authoring domain.OnboardingPathAuthoringInput, fingerprint string, targets []domain.LearningTarget, transitions []domain.TransitionKnowledge, strategies pedagogy.Registry) (domain.GeneratedCourse, error) {
	type sectionKey struct{ module, section string }
	type lessonKey struct{ module, section, lesson string }
	modules := make([]domain.PlannedModule, 0)
	moduleIndex := map[string]int{}
	sectionIndex := map[sectionKey]int{}
	lessonIndex := map[lessonKey]int{}
	for _, target := range targets {
		mi, exists := moduleIndex[target.ModuleCode]
		if !exists {
			mi = len(modules)
			moduleIndex[target.ModuleCode] = mi
			modules = append(modules, domain.PlannedModule{Code: target.ModuleCode, Title: target.ModuleTitle, Order: target.ModuleOrder})
		}
		sk := sectionKey{target.ModuleCode, target.SectionCode}
		si, exists := sectionIndex[sk]
		if !exists {
			si = len(modules[mi].Sections)
			sectionIndex[sk] = si
			modules[mi].Sections = append(modules[mi].Sections, domain.PlannedSection{Code: target.SectionCode, Title: target.SectionTitle, Order: target.SectionOrder})
		}
		var lessonTransitions []domain.TransitionKnowledge
		for _, transition := range transitions {
			if domain.TargetIdentity(transition.Target) == domain.TargetIdentity(target.Ref) {
				lessonTransitions = append(lessonTransitions, transition)
			}
		}
		section := &modules[mi].Sections[si]
		lk := lessonKey{target.ModuleCode, target.SectionCode, target.LessonCode}
		li, exists := lessonIndex[lk]
		if !exists {
			li = len(section.Lessons)
			lessonIndex[lk] = li
			section.Lessons = append(section.Lessons, domain.PlannedLesson{Code: target.LessonCode, Title: target.LessonTitle, Excerpt: target.LessonExcerpt, Order: target.LessonOrder, Status: domain.LessonStatusPlanned, Targets: []domain.TargetRef{target.Ref}, Prerequisites: append([]domain.TargetRef(nil), target.Prerequisites...), TransitionKnowledge: lessonTransitions})
			continue
		}
		lesson := &section.Lessons[li]
		lesson.Targets = appendS9Target(lesson.Targets, target.Ref)
		for _, prerequisite := range target.Prerequisites {
			lesson.Prerequisites = appendS9Target(lesson.Prerequisites, prerequisite)
		}
		lesson.TransitionKnowledge = append(lesson.TransitionKnowledge, lessonTransitions...)
	}
	for mi := range modules {
		module := &modules[mi]
		sort.Slice(module.Sections, func(i, j int) bool {
			if module.Sections[i].Order != module.Sections[j].Order {
				return module.Sections[i].Order < module.Sections[j].Order
			}
			return module.Sections[i].Code < module.Sections[j].Code
		})
		for si := range module.Sections {
			section := &module.Sections[si]
			sort.Slice(section.Lessons, func(i, j int) bool {
				if section.Lessons[i].Order != section.Lessons[j].Order {
					return section.Lessons[i].Order < section.Lessons[j].Order
				}
				return section.Lessons[i].Code < section.Lessons[j].Code
			})
			for li := range section.Lessons {
				lesson := &section.Lessons[li]
				lesson.Targets, lesson.Prerequisites = domain.SortTargetRefs(lesson.Targets), domain.SortTargetRefs(lesson.Prerequisites)
				selected, err := strategies.Select(policy.PedagogyStrategies, pedagogy.LessonContext{Targets: lesson.Targets, TransitionKnowledge: lesson.TransitionKnowledge, SelfAssessedExperience: authoring.SelfAssessedExperience})
				if err != nil {
					return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, err
				}
				lesson.PedagogyStrategies = selected
			}
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(modules, func(i, j int) bool {
		if modules[i].Order != modules[j].Order {
			return modules[i].Order < modules[j].Order
		}
		return modules[i].Code < modules[j].Code
	})
	return domain.GeneratedCourse{Fingerprint: fingerprint, FingerprintVersion: domain.CourseFingerprintVersion, GoalCode: graph.Goal.Code, GoalVersion: graph.Goal.Version, Title: graph.Goal.Title, Description: graph.Goal.Description, Language: authoring.ContentLanguage, Status: domain.CourseStatusActiveBuilding, CatalogVisible: false, PlannerVersion: policy.PlannerVersion, PedagogyProfile: policy.PedagogyProfile, PresentationStyle: policy.PresentationStyle, GenerationPolicy: policy.GenerationPolicy, Modules: modules}, nil
}

func appendS9Target(inputs []domain.TargetRef, candidate domain.TargetRef) []domain.TargetRef {
	for _, input := range inputs {
		if domain.TargetIdentity(input) == domain.TargetIdentity(candidate) {
			return inputs
		}
	}
	return append(inputs, candidate)
}
